patch_description: Add constraint-gradient-informed proposals to the local polishing phase. The current polish relies on isotropic random perturbations, which are inefficient near a maximin optimum because only a small set of near-minimum triangles controls the objective. For the currently smallest signed determinants, this edit computes their determinant gradients with respect to each free point, aggregates ascent directions, and evaluates projected steps at several magnitudes. Random trials remain available afterward for escaping nonsmooth local configurations, while the directed trials deliberately increase active triangle areas.
